updates.classification: Original assembly photo-qualified bent-back nominal MC78M05 TO220 body-only illustration
limitations: Original author assembly instruction explicitly says to bend IC20 back before fitting the heatsink; the original place/soldered/measure photos show the body and tab approximately parallel to the PCB and extending beyond its edge.
The exact 90 degree angle, bend datum and 2.0 mm vertical placement are illustration assumptions, not measurements from the photograph or a manufacturer formed-lead specification.
All IC20 leads remain omitted. The prior nominal published lead width/hole fit was unresolved; no terminals were thinned, displaced or invented to conceal it.

The paired seat uses source-consistent through-hole and contact-plane alignment, inherited from the nominal generic TO220 body. Actual original regulator vendor/suffix, lead forming, cut lengths and installed seat require physical confirmation.
The complete revision 9 heatsink is only rigidly rotated and translated. No fold, spring finger, wall, source envelope or neighboring component is trimmed or shrunk.

Free-state reconstructed spring fingers retain a nominal 1.729422 mm3 regulator intersection. This is a documented geometric overlap, not a simulation or certification of elastic clamping, contact force or thermal performance.
Case placement, board seat and neighboring package models remain qualified visual geometry. A clear surface screen does not establish tolerance or physical fit.

limitations: Original independent parameterized reconstruction from primary manufacturer drawings, not redistributed manufacturer CAD.
Published nominal envelopes/apertures retained at unity scale. Original canonical front/body-seat datum, offset0, rotation0 and native footprint pose are preserved.
Below-seat terminals, solder lugs and locators are omitted. These candidates do not demonstrate PCB lead fit or installed seating.

Exact historical supplied revision, mold, plating and physical fit remain unverified. Contemporary datasheets are references for a family illustration.

2010 revisionB and2020 revision1.02 dimension-lines imply nominal terminal positions(0,2.3),(0,16),(5.2,13.5), consistent with the current drawing; 11.2 is terminal1-to-terminal3, not terminal1-to-terminal2.
The source records reengineering in2023 and2024. Equal printed nominal dimensions do not prove unchanged mold or terminal tolerances.
Original PCB rounddrills2.54 and slightly displaced center positions differ from manufacturer slotted-hole recommendations; no leads were narrowed or shifted to fit.
No nut or thread is added: MJ-3536N is the nonthreaded6mm-bushing family, distinct from threaded sibling variants.
Roof height7.5, slope breakpoints2.3/10.0, recessed window7.1wide, contactstock0.27/0.30 and14.1mm internal bore depth are visual assumptions, not manufacturer callouts.
